text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I go see a movie to relax, and when I
come out...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
H-hello. You're a trainer from the
academy,
right? Did you also happen to
watch this movie?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
R-really?! If you don't mind, I'd love to
know what
you thought of it.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Sorry for asking all of a sudden. It's
just... this
movie is based off one of my
favorite books.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I'm so happy it got a movie adaptation, I
can't
help but want to know what others
thought of it!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Yes! That scene had me at the edge of
my seat
too!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
It's no wonder speed and tension are
such
important elements for movies...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Y-yes, you're right! I feel like I've
learned
something new.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
By the way, in the novel, the hero and
heroine
originally confessed to each
other while fleeing
on foot...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
But I think the scene gained a lot more
presence
after being changed to a car
chase. The stunt
driving was
breathtaking as well!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I wish they focused more on the
subtleties of their
emotions, though. For
example, they could've
abandoned the
car and gone on foot so that...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
O-oh! Sorry for rambling... I didn't mean
to get so
carried away!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Zenno Rob Roy's fangirling is just as
fast-paced
and action-packed as the
film.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I know just what you mean! The visuals
were
stunning, and they perfectly
captured the world
and atmosphere that
was in the book.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
The musical score was a perfect
accompaniment
too. Listening to it really
refreshed me.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
In fact, I feel so energized, I'm sure I can
do my
very best during training
tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
And the more I train, the stronger I'll
become,
which means I'm sure to do well
in my next race!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
And if I keep winning, my life will
become its own
story...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Then someone will write a book about
me, and
it'll get its own movie
adaptation, and...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Gasp! No way... Did I say all that out loud?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Aaaaah! Please forget everything I said!
